description: Implement ONE pure frontend helper, not the game AI.
requirements: Output exactly one exported TypeScript function controlledRoleLabel(state: GameState): string. No imports, no other functions, no markdown.
Find the player in state.players whose id equals state.controlledId. If not found return "Player".
If the selected player role equals "keeper", return "Goalkeeper".
For selected outfield tacticalRole "attacker", "midfielder", "defender", return respectively "Attacker", "Midfielder", "Defender".
If tacticalRole is missing or unknown return "Outfield player".
Do not modify state; do not perform IO, network calls, DOM changes or commands. Return a string only.

GameState type is already imported in src/ui.ts. Shape: { controlledId:string, players:Array<{id:string,role:"outfield"|"keeper",tacticalRole?:"attacker"|"midfielder"|"defender"}> }. Preserve existing completedPayload function; only return your NEW function as code.
